# Results

<!-- results:start (generated by scripts/analyze_mac.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Routing (H3, pre-registered).** Chosen on validation, the `cascade margin` policy saved **29%** of measured energy per request on 135 held-out items at **-2.2 accuracy points** (95% CI -5.9 to +1.5) versus always using Qwen2.5-7B. That meets the thresholds (at least 25% saved, at most 5 points lost) on point estimates; the accuracy interval reaches past the tolerance, so support is tentative.

| Configuration | Tier | Accuracy (95% CI) | Median latency | Energy per request |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| qwen7b-q4 | device | 74.7% (70.7 to 78.7) | 268 ms | 18.3 J |
| qwen1.5b-q4 | device | 65.8% (61.3 to 70.0) | 69 ms | 3.8 J |
| qwen1.5b-q4 | edge | 65.8% (61.3 to 70.2) | 475 ms (1 of 3 domains) | excluded (swap) |
| mistral7b-q4 | device | 65.3% (60.9 to 69.8) | 283 ms | 19.1 J |
| qwen1.5b-q8 | device | 64.4% (60.2 to 68.9) | 61 ms | 3.4 J |
| qwen0.5b-q8 | device | 41.3% (36.9 to 46.0) | 26 ms | 1.0 J |
| qwen0.5b-q8 | edge | 40.4% (36.0 to 44.9) | 155 ms | 2.3 J |
| qwen0.5b-q4 | device | 37.3% (32.9 to 41.8) | 29 ms | 1.1 J |
| qwen0.5b-q4 | edge | 37.3% (32.9 to 41.8) | 160 ms | 2.5 J |

Energy is measured incremental CPU+GPU+ANE energy from `powermetrics` on one M1 Max (idle 1.48 W subtracted). The edge tier is the same Mac's CPU, an emulation of a small server. Cells with memory page-outs are excluded from latency and energy.
<!-- results:end -->

The full report is in [`paper/report.pdf`](https://github.com/Agent007repo/continuum-bench/blob/main/paper/report.pdf). Every number here is regenerated by `make analyze` from the raw records in `results/mac/`.
